text:
ana: heads up - ran a partial replay for eu-agg-hours (2026-03-12 00:00-04:00) and totals are 1.8x expected. looks like duplicate ingestion in several shards.
ben: which job id? can you paste the console link?
ana: job id rply-9910 - https://console/replays/rply-9910 - mode: full, dedupe=false (used quick flow)
ops-bot: replay job rply-9910 started by ana - status: running - writes: enabled - priority: normal
tess: quick flow defaulting dedupe=false is a UX footgun. we've tripped this before.
omar: immediate mitigation: pause writes so we don't commit bad aggregates, then run a small canary with dedupe=true and sample on shards.
ana: pausing writes now: `./replay update rply-9910 --writes disabled` -> confirmed.
ops-bot: rply-9910 writes disabled by ana - job in compute-only mode
ben: we don't have a sample_rate param on internal API yet. we only support explicit shard list. we should add sample_rate + tag output with meta.recompute_phase.
jamie: agree. also add `skip_writes` and `dry_run` flags and a `canary` priority so scheduler sends to spot pool and applies quota caps.
tess: console side: show a red modal if dedupe=false and window > 30m, require ack. add a dropdown for "canary sample" with 1%, 10%, 25% options and a badge on job list that says [CANARY].
ben: for now I'll spin up a manual canary: POST /internal/replay { target: "eu-agg-hours", from: "2026-03-12T00:00", to: "2026-03-12T04:00", shard_sample: 0.1, dedupe: true, priority: "canary", max_tokens: "200000" }
jamie: routing note: ensure canary pool uses isolated tokens to avoid hitting Dedicated or preempting user routes. ops will reserve a small spot pool.
omar: also need telemetry: tag rows with `meta.recompute_tag=canary-5054335000` and expose `recompute_tag` in dashboards so panels can filter canary outputs out of SLOs.
a: small ask - can CLI warn if user runs `replay run` with dedupe=false and window >= 30m? that will reduce accidental runs.
ben: I'll add a CLI guard and a console modal RFC. will put draft RFC in docs: /docs/replay/canary-guard.md
tess: action list: (1) ben open internal endpoint change for sample_rate + tags, (2) jamie reserve spot pool + quota caps, (3) tess add console modal + badge, (4) omar put telemetry tag shim, (5) ana run canary and share diff.
ops-bot: canary job queued: rply-9911 - status: queued - priority: canary
jamie: deploying small changes to replay-svc canary now.
nana: thanks team. posting canary diffs in this thread when done. :eyes:
